errors.evidence: This phrase is misleading. While the y-axis itself lacks a label, the first sentence of the description correctly identifies that the metric is "measured using the GEMBA-SQM scale." Stating later that "no units are specified" creates a confusing contradiction.
The description fails to mention that the exact numerical values are annotated above each bar. The prompt explicitly asks to mention if bars are visually emphasized through annotation.

The prompt requires the description to include "representative values from the shortest and tallest bars." While the description provides the values for all bars, it does not explicitly identify V3 as the tallest (94.5) and V4 as the shortest (91.1).
